description: This Java class 'SecurityController' manages user profile viewing and editing functionalities, including profile display, user detail updates, and patching user details, with role-based access control.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Controller handling user profile display and editing, secured with role-based authorization.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the current user's profile, including enrolled courses.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve user data for editing, with authentication check.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to update user details after authentication verification.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to patch user details with authentication verification.
